title: ranunculus aduncus subsp. gouanii
intro: Ranunculus aduncus subsp. gouanii, commonly known as the Spotted Ranunculus or Gouan's Buttercup, is a plant species in the Ranunculaceae family, characterized by its bright yellow flowers with distinctive black spots. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Ranunculus aduncus subsp. gouanii are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial activity, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include saponins, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
